architecture_upgrade: CCCXXIX integrated the beta flow.  CCCXXX shows the integrated flow is the projectivization of exp(tG) for a traceless 2x2 generator satisfying G^2=(5049/4)I.  Thus the RG renderer is a finite PSL(2)-type action.

checks.name: Mobius derivative equals beta at t=0
forward Mobius action moves toward attracting branch

honesty_boundary: This proves the finite RG renderer is projective/Mobius.  It still does not assign physical continuum units to t or y.
theorem: The finite RG flow dy/dt=140+67y-y^2 is the Riccati/projective flow induced by G=[[67/2,140],[1,-67/2]].  Since G^2=(5049/4)I, exp(tG) is closed in hyperbolic form and has projective eigenvalue gap sqrt(5049).
title: Projective RG Renderer Compiler
